name: Craonne
summary: Napoleon attacked Vorontsov's and Sacken's Russians on the narrow Chemin des Dames plateau; Ney and Victor's Young Guard came on in costly frontal assaults until the Russians withdrew in good order, one of the bloodiest days of the campaign.

toCome.name: Ney's Infantry
toCome.formation: Boyer's 9th Division and Meunier's and Curial's Young Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Attacked the Russian left up onto the plateau from Vauclair; Boyer's division took Ailles by three, and Curial's pressed the last attack with Friant's.

toCome.name: Victor's Young Guard
toCome.formation: Charpentier's 7th and Boyer de Rébeval's 2nd Provisional Young Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Boyer de Rébeval's conscripts took the Bois Marion at noon and were thrown out by a dragoon charge; Charpentier's took the Bois des Quatre Heures. Victor was wounded early in the day.

toCome.name: Grouchy's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Laferrière's 3rd Guard Cavalry and Roussel d'Hurbal's 6th Heavy Divisions
toCome.summary: Charged the Russian centre and its battery and were driven back by the squares; Grouchy and Laferrière were wounded.

toCome.name: Nansouty's Cavalry
toCome.summary: Went up the Paissy spur on the Russian right and drove back Benckendorff's horse until the guns stopped them.

toCome.name: Mortier's Reserve
toCome.formation: Friant's and Christiani's Old Guard, Poret de Morvan's Young Guard and Colbert's Guard Cavalry Divisions
toCome.summary: Friant's division came up behind the final attack; Colbert's horse, sent to the left, was driven off by the Russian hussars. Drouot massed eighty-eight guns against the Russian lines.

toCome.name: Vorontsov's Corps
toCome.formation: Vuich's 24th, Laptev's 21st, Khovansky's 12th and Zheltukhin's 13th Divisions, with Krasovsky's Jäger and Benckendorff's brigade
toCome.summary: Held the narrow plateau of the Chemin des Dames in lines across it through the day, and withdrew in good order.

toCome.name: Vasilchikov's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Lanskoy's 2nd Hussar and Panchulidzev's 3rd Dragoon Divisions, with Karpov's Cossacks
toCome.summary: Charged Colbert's and Grouchy's squadrons; Lanskoy was mortally wounded.

toCome.name: Sacken's Corps
toCome.summary: Its cavalry and Nikitin's guns covered Vorontsov's retreat; its infantry was too far off to fight.
